runtime: ONNX Runtime Web 1.30.0 WASM, numThreads=1 per worker
fixture: scripts/ocr-fixture.ts quarryMap(): 3000×2400 JPEG-compressed quarry sheet, 170 labels at 11–36 px in nine fonts, rotated, coloured, haloed and white-on-dark, over galleries, pillars and a grid
scoring: A label counts when searching its full text highlights its own position; word recall does the same per word of two or more characters; spurious lines lie on no label.
methodology: npm run benchmark:ocr -- <workers>; each worker is a Node worker thread with its own engines, as in the app. Scan time excludes model loading (about 180 ms).

previous.pipeline: PP-OCRv5 detector capped at 768 px + Tesseract tessdata_fast English, one worker

current.pipeline: PP-OCRv5 detector at native resolution + PP-LCNet text-line orientation + latin PP-OCRv5 recognizer

memory: One engine raised Node RSS by about 145 MB when loaded and 330 MB at its scanning peak; the app runs at most three workers, fewer when navigator.deviceMemory is low.
limits: Synthetic desktop measurements through native canvas; no browser, GPU or phone timing. Most remaining misses are 11–13 px labels and labels crossed by gallery walls.
